title: Wayfare Pass Ride Credit Rulebook — Amount of Credit a Trip Earns
content:
# Amount of Pass ride credit a trip earns — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule

1. Only trips in a ride option listed among the plan's credit-earning ride options earn credit, reserved trips included, and wait time, tolls, airport fees, Priority Pickup, reservation fees and tips never count.
2. The trip ride credit is the plan's credit rate applied to the eligible fare, where the eligible fare is the trip's fare charge less the ride option's booking fee and never below 0.00.
3. It is rounded half up to the cent, capped at the plan's per-trip cap and at what remains of the plan's monthly cap, counted over the Pass ride credit posted to the membership after the same day of the previous month less the credit forfeited in that time, and a trip whose eligible fare is under the plan's minimum eligible fare earns nothing.
4. For this monthly cap the rolling month above takes the place of the calendar month of the drop-off that the plan's credit-month basis sets for monthly credit caps: a credit is never held back by the credit already counted in the calendar month of its drop-off, and the calendar month of the drop-off recorded on each credit entry only shows when the trip was taken.
5. The trip ride credit is rounded half up to the cent as its final amount.

## Quantities and where they come from

| Quantity | Source |
|---|---|
| Fare charge | The trip's fare charge in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) |
| Booking fee | The booking fee of the trip's ride option in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) |
| Credit rate, per-trip cap, monthly cap, minimum eligible fare, credit-earning ride options | The plan's figures in the Wayfare Pass ride credit earning schedule |
| Credit counted toward the monthly cap | Credit earn entries posted to the membership after the same day of the previous month, less credit forfeiture entries in that time |

The room under the monthly cap is the monthly cap less the credit counted toward it, and never below 0.00. The credit is the smallest of the rounded rate amount, the per-trip cap and that room.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

The plan is Wayfare Pass Monthly: rate 6 percent, per-trip cap 10.00, monthly cap 60.00, minimum eligible fare 5.00. The trip is a Wayfare Standard trip with a fare charge of 32.70 and a booking fee taken as 2.70.

1. Eligible fare: 32.70 less 2.70 is 30.00, not under 5.00. Rate amount: 6 percent of 30.00 is 1.80. Credit counted in the rolling month: 12.40 posted, nothing forfeited, so 47.60 remains. Credit: 1.80.
2. Same trip, with 59.00 posted in the rolling month and 0.50 forfeited in it: 58.50 counted, 1.50 remains. Credit: 1.50.
3. Same trip, with 61.00 posted in the rolling month: nothing remains. Credit: 0.00.
4. A trip in a ride option the plan does not list, for example a Wayfare Black trip on Wayfare Pass Monthly: 0.00.
5. A fare charge of 7.40 with a 2.70 booking fee: eligible fare 4.70, under 5.00: 0.00.
